baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence taking, oaths, shield, diversion, path, and work makes one deliberately operated mechanism.
baseline_models.mechanism: They appropriate a binding speech act, refashion it as defensive equipment, and use that equipment to redirect movement from a traversable divine way. The closing evaluation treats the whole conversion and deployment as intentional work, not merely an untrue sentence.

activation_trace.role: Making or acquiring something for oneself supplies the deliberate conversion of an oath into owned equipment.
The oath and pledged bond supply the speech-act material being converted.
The protective shield supplies the defensive function assigned to the oath.
Turning away and turning another away supplies the shield's directional effect.
The extended traversable road makes the diverted movement concrete rather than merely thematic.
Intentional action classifies the whole protective-diverting sequence as purposive work.

changed_reading.before: They tell false oaths to protect themselves and then block God's path.
changed_reading.after: They manufacture a defensive instrument out of binding speech and deliberately operate it to redirect traffic from God's way.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concealment branch of j-n-n and the barrier branch of s-d-d connect the oath's hidden interior to the obstruction it creates outside.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath first covers what would expose them; repeated public use then gives that cover the social solidity of intervening terrain. Hidden shame is not merely kept private: concealment itself becomes the obstacle encountered by anyone trying to discern or traverse the way.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies a publicly credible outer statement capable of covering an inner contradiction.
Concealment from perception supplies the hidden interior of the mechanism.
The shameful thing whose exposure is avoided supplies what the cover protects from view.
A mountain-like barrier turns private concealment into public obstructive terrain.
The road supplies the route whose visibility and passage are impaired by that terrain.

changed_reading.before: The oaths are a shield against accusation.
changed_reading.after: The oaths hide the compromising interior so effectively that concealment hardens into the terrain blocking discernment and passage.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Ayman can activate not only oath but the right side as power, capacity, and warding, while taking and shielding keep that activation tied to the clause.
baseline_models.mechanism: Alongside the straightforward oath reading, they appropriate their socially recognized powers, rights, or strongest means and place them between themselves and accountability. The barrier is therefore potentially institutional: protected standing can turn travelers away even when no explicit lie is being uttered at that moment.

activation_trace.role: Appropriation for oneself supplies the capture of a resource or prerogative.
Right-sided power, capacity, and warding supply the social force latent beside the primary oath sense.
The shield assigns that appropriated force a defensive posture.
Diversion gives protected power an outward effect on others' direction.
Travelers and road users make the object of institutional obstruction a community, not an abstraction.

changed_reading.before: Their protection consists only in verbal oaths.
changed_reading.after: Their oaths coexist with an image of appropriated right and social power, deployed as defensive authority over other people's movement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The temporal presence of kana with ongoing work lets the oath-shield read as a maintained operation rather than one isolated incident.
baseline_models.mechanism: Oath-making functions as a reusable defensive procedure. They repeatedly activate speech as shielding whenever exposure threatens, so the closing censure assesses an operating practice and the kind of agents it produces.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the repeatable speech act at the center of the procedure.
The shield supplies the stable function for which each speech act is deployed.
Occurrence and presence in time supply persistence to the ensuing imperfect work.
Operating or putting something to use makes the shield a repeatedly activated instrument.
The formal censure evaluates the sustained mode of operation rather than only its verbal contents.

changed_reading.before: A false oath is used once to escape a charge.
changed_reading.after: Oath-as-cover is a maintained operating practice whose recurrent use is itself the condemned work.

context_deltas.mechanism: The oath-shield becomes a counterfeit verification system. Public testimony imitates informed evidence, while the displayed entrance and hidden exit of n-f-q and the garment that lies by its appearance explain how an apparently inspectable claim is built with an escape route from accountability.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the binding evidentiary form being counterfeited.
The shield supplies the protection gained when the counterfeit is accepted.
A shown entrance with a hidden exit supplies the asymmetric architecture of public access and concealed escape.
A thing's saying as its indication lets their utterance pose as a sign of the reality it conceals.
Testimony that declares from knowledge supplies the evidentiary standard their declaration mimics.
The garment that lies by its condition supplies a visible facade whose presentation misreports what is underneath.

structural_cues: 63:1 alternates their testimony with God's knowledge and counter-testimony before naming them liars.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies doubled testimony, informed witness, a deceptive facade, and a visible entrance with a hidden exit; I infer that the oath reroutes verification into a credential they control. The live alternative is the simpler use of an oath only after suspicion arises.

changed_reading.before: The oath is a defensive statement that repels an accusation.
changed_reading.after: The oath is counterfeit evidence: a public credential designed to look inspectable while preserving a concealed exit from scrutiny.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exterior shield feeds back into the operator. A sequence of trusted assent, covering, stamping, reversal of the heart, and failed understanding makes repeated defensive work look like a production line: what first hides the person eventually imprints the person.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the outward cover whose effects can migrate inward.
Being imprinted or disposed for work links recurrent practice to the context's explicit stamp image.
Assent that settles the heart supplies the initially available orientation later reversed.
Covering supplies the hinge between the chosen outer shield and the subsequent inner closure.
A seal that stamps an image supplies the mechanism by which repeated cover becomes fixed form.
Turning a thing from its face supplies the reversal of the heart's receptive orientation.
Understanding supplies the faculty lost when the defensive pattern becomes an inner seal.

structural_cues: 63:3 orders assent, subsequent covering, a seal on hearts, and failure to understand as one consequence chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the ordered cover-to-stamp sequence and a focus branch for one imprinted for work; I infer a feedback arrow from repeatedly operated concealment to formed incapacity. A live alternative treats the seal solely as imposed consequence rather than habituation, without removing the sequence's resonance.

changed_reading.before: The oath-shield remains an external tactic used by an unchanged operator.
changed_reading.after: Repeatedly operating the external cover stamps an inward disposition, so the shield eventually remakes and closes its user.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shield reads as an alarm-triggered response system. An impressive bodily and verbal facade is only propped support; conjecture classifies every frightening sound as incoming threat, prompting defensive speech before any charge is established.

activation_trace.role: The shield supplies the countermeasure that the alarm system deploys.
The gathered visible body supplies the impressive exterior carrying the defense.
Rigid timber supplies the inert material beneath the socially persuasive exterior.
Reliance and leaning supply the prop that keeps the defensive display upright.
Conjecture supplies the threat-classification step rather than verified knowledge.
The frightening shout supplies the signal that automatically activates defensive posture.

structural_cues: 63:4 moves from admired appearance and compelling speech to propped timber and then to interpreting every shout as directed against them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a supported facade, conjectural threat reading, and universalized alarm; I infer that oath-shields are preemptive countermeasures in a hypervigilant loop. The live alternative is that the verse exposes fear without making every oath an automatic response.

changed_reading.before: They raise an oath-shield after a specific accusation.
changed_reading.after: Their persuasive facade is coupled to a threat sensor that treats any signal as accusation and preemptively deploys protective speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The directional ambiguity of s-d-d becomes productive rather than resolved. Twisted bodies and turned heads show self-diversion from an offered route, while the visible arrogant recoil also discourages and redirects others; self-turning and other-barring coexist in one public gesture.

activation_trace.role: The branch explicitly supplies both turning oneself and turning another away, preserving both directions.
The traversable route supplies the orientation from which bodies and audiences are redirected.
Bending until something turns off line supplies the bodily onset of self-diversion.
The head and upper part locate the refusal in an observable bodily orientation.
The repeated turning/diverting root carries the focus action into the embodied refusal scene.
Pride and self-magnification make private recoil into a public status performance with deterrent force.

structural_cues: 63:5 places an invitation toward forgiveness before head-twisting, visible turning, and arrogant persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an offered direction, bodily twisting, repeated s-d-d, and pride; I infer that the same act first reorients the subjects and then exerts social force on observers. The live alternative keeps either the intransitive or transitive force primary, but neither needs to erase the other.

changed_reading.before: They only bar other people from God's path.
changed_reading.after: They first turn their own bodies and attention away, then make that conspicuous recoil an obstacle that turns others as well.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two covers compete. Their self-made shield conceals them from correction, while forgiveness is a cover that protects from the consequence of exposed wrong; guidance is the gentle route toward that second cover. The image of a moist fruit leaving its peel sharpens the reversal: the chosen protection accompanies departure from the envelope that could preserve it.

activation_trace.role: The self-fashioned shield supplies counterfeit protection from exposure.
The path supplies the route that counterfeit protection prevents them from taking.
Equivalence supplies the hardened state in which requesting or withholding a plea no longer changes the outcome.
Covering sin while preserving its bearer from the effect supplies restorative protection opposed to concealment.
Gentle indication toward the true road connects restorative cover back to the blocked path.
A fresh fruit slipping out of its peel supplies the exploratory reversal from apparent shielding to loss of a preserving envelope.

structural_cues: 63:6 makes asking and not asking forgiveness equivalent, then denies guidance to the named group.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a focus shield, forgiveness as protective covering, path-guidance, and departure from a peel; I infer a contrast between counterfeit and restorative protection. The fruit image is an analogical intensifier, while the live alternative reads f-s-q without material imagery.

changed_reading.before: Their oath-shield successfully protects them from an immediate social consequence.
changed_reading.after: The counterfeit cover protects them from correction by shutting them out of the restorative cover and route that could actually preserve them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Path-blocking acquires a material implementation. The group with a hidden exit attempts to stop outward expenditure until the people around the Messenger break apart, turning control of an outlet into control of social cohesion; the divine treasuries expose their claimed choke point as contingent.

activation_trace.role: Diversion and prevention supply the social purpose of the resource restriction.
A rim or projecting outlet supplies the focus-side image of a passage whose flow can be pinched.
Money going out in expenditure supplies the material flow they order others to stop.
The displayed entrance and hidden outlet connect the same root's group label to asymmetric control of circulation.
The breaking apart of a gathered group supplies the intended social result of withholding flow.
Securely stored treasure supplies the larger reserve that defeats their attempted monopoly over the outlet.

structural_cues: 63:7 orders spending stopped until a community disperses, then answers that policy with God's ownership of the treasuries of heaven and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stopped expenditure, intended dispersal, a root joining expenditure to the named group, and superior treasuries; I infer that resource restriction operationalizes the focus's blocking. The live alternative keeps the focus chiefly rhetorical while treating the economic tactic as a later example.

changed_reading.before: They obstruct the way through deceptive religious speech.
changed_reading.after: Their protected speech authorizes a choke point where material outflow is withheld to fragment the community using the way.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exploratory power reading becomes spatially concrete. Return to a gathered city, projected expulsion, and a coercive strong/abased polarity turn oath-backed standing into a claim over the civic threshold: who may remain, who must leave, and whose movement counts as legitimate.

activation_trace.role: Power, right, and warding supply the claimed authority behind civic exclusion.
The barrier image supplies the threshold at which claimed authority interrupts passage.
Road users and travelers supply the persons subjected to the claimed jurisdiction.
Returning to a prior place supplies movement toward the civic threshold.
The city as gathered polity supplies the jurisdiction they imagine controlling.
Penetration to the outside supplies the threatened expulsion across that threshold.
Dominance and coercion supply the force by which the speaker claims to decide passage.
Breaking under coercion supplies the status assigned to whoever is to be expelled.

structural_cues: 63:8 encloses the strong-versus-abased boast inside return to the city and threatened expulsion, then reallocates might to God, the Messenger, and believers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies return, city, exit, and coercive rank; I infer that oath-backed right is projected as border authority. The live alternative treats the boast as fantasy rather than actual jurisdiction, which weakens possession but strengthens the compensatory function of the shield.

changed_reading.before: Their oath-backed power gives general social protection.
changed_reading.after: They use protected standing to imagine civic sovereignty over routes, thresholds, inclusion, and expulsion, even as the context reverses their rank claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The object protected by the oath-shield comes into partial view as an acquisitive attention regime. Acquired wealth and generated lineage occupy attention away from remembrance; the oath behaves like a document securing those claims, while the counter-document of remembrance asserts a prior right over present action.

activation_trace.role: Acquisition for oneself supplies the possessive logic joining shield-making to accumulated assets.
The oath supplies a binding claim-form capable of defending the possessive order.
Occupation by one thing away from another supplies the attentional diversion parallel to path diversion.
Taking and multiplying wealth supplies one accumulating object defended by the system.
Something produced from something else supplies lineage as an expanding output of the possessive order.
Bringing something back to presence after forgetfulness supplies the displaced orientation.
A document of right lets remembrance activate as a counter-claim against oath-secured possessions.
Commercial loss reverses the apparent success of the asset-protection strategy.

structural_cues: 63:9 names wealth and children as agents of diversion from remembrance and immediately redescribes successful possession as loss.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies acquisition, attention displaced by wealth and offspring, remembrance, a right-document branch, and commercial loss; I infer that oath-shields defend an asset-centered claim system. The live alternative is that the context diagnoses distraction without specifying what the earlier oaths protect.

changed_reading.before: The oath-shield protects a concealed religious identity.
changed_reading.after: It also protects an acquisitive order in which wealth and lineage monopolize attention and binding claims displace remembrance's prior claim.

context_deltas.mechanism: The shield gains a temporal dimension: pledged future action substitutes for present work and buys apparent delay. Near death, the same structure appears as 'defer me and I will give and become righteous,' but the fixed term, promise-fulfillment branch, and final knowledge of deeds collapse declaration back into enacted history.

activation_trace.role: The oath supplies the pledged future claim that can stand in for present action.
Occurrence through time locates judgment in what has actually been present and done.
Loss of life and power supplies the boundary at which deferred performance can no longer be substituted.
Deferral to a later time supplies the requested temporal shelter.
The fixed limit of time supplies the boundary the shelter cannot cross.
Making a promise true in action exposes the gap between a projected future self and present fulfillment.
The repeated deferral image is categorically denied once the term arrives.
The arrived limit closes the temporal opening that promissory speech seeks.
Knowledge of the report and inner reality defeats a last verbal substitution for actual deeds.
Intentional enacted work supplies the final record against which promised future action is measured.

structural_cues: 63:10 places a future promise after death's arrival; 63:11 answers that no self is deferred when its term arrives and closes on knowledge of deeds.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a request for delay, projected future virtue, fixed term, fulfilled promise, and informed judgment of work; I infer that oath-like future speech can function as temporal cover. The live alternative restricts 63:2 to social concealment while treating procrastination as a parallel later failure.

changed_reading.before: The oath-shield hides present identity from other people.
changed_reading.after: Promissory speech also shields the present from action by exporting reform into the future, until the fixed term collapses words back into the work actually done.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it composes three material branches rather than proposing a lexical translation. It remains focus-anchored in taking as a water-holding basin, s-d-d as a route to water, and s-b-l as rain suspended between sky and earth; downstream prose should mark it as a hydrological systems image, not as the direct sense of the clause.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus contains a holding structure, a route to water, and a suspended downward flow among its own branch inventories.

activation_trace.role: A basin that holds water for days supplies an image of credibility being impounded rather than allowed to circulate.
A road leading to water supplies the access line disrupted by the holding structure.
Rain flowing between cloud and earth supplies guidance as a life-bearing flow not yet delivered to its destination.
A rim or outlet supplies the controllable point at which an impounded flow can be released or withheld.

changed_reading.before: The oath is a static wall beside a road.
changed_reading.after: The oath-system impounds and controls a life-bearing flow of credibility and guidance at its outlet, preventing it from reaching travelers.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because mirror cosmetic, eye-film, and admired-appearance images cross from movement into optics. It remains anchored in the focus's s-d-d and s-b-l branches and is activated by 63:4's seeing and visual admiration; downstream prose should present it as an account of managed perception, not as a replacement translation of 'they turned away.'
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus joins a concealing shield to a mirror cosmetic and an eye veil among the branches of its obstruction and path roots.

activation_trace.role: Concealment from perception supplies the optical purpose of the oath surface.
Cosmetic rubbed on a mirror and then applied to the eye supplies a mediated surface that alters seeing.
A woven-looking film over the eye supplies perceptual obstruction rather than a physical roadblock.
View, appearance, and mirror supply the context in which the focus's optical branches become operational.
Beauty in the observer's eye supplies the successful perceptual effect of the managed surface.

changed_reading.before: They stop movement along a visible road.
changed_reading.after: They coat the field of vision so that a polished public surface is mistaken for reality and the route can no longer be correctly seen.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the rare death-side branch of y-m-n and the burial branch of j-n-n. It remains anchored in the two adjacent focus words and gains a remote check from death as stillness in 63:10; downstream prose should call it a mortuary resonance showing the cost of protection, never a claim that ayman directly means corpses here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The adjacent focus roots for oaths and shield each contain a death-oriented branch: being laid on the right and being covered in burial.

activation_trace.role: Death associated with being laid on the right supplies a terminal underside to the apparent protection.
Covering and burying the dead supplies protection that seals away rather than preserves living responsiveness.
Covering reason supplies the moral and cognitive stillness produced before physical death.
Stillness and loss of activity supply a context echo for a defense that preserves position by extinguishing response.

changed_reading.after: At the image level, their chosen protection resembles self-burial: it secures the exterior by covering reason and stilling the capacity to respond.

strongest_changes: 63:1 changes a defensive oath into counterfeit evidence with a public entrance and concealed exit.
63:3 changes an external shield into a repeated practice that stamps and reverses the inner operator.
63:5 preserves both self-turning and other-barring as one embodied social action.
63:7 and 63:8 materialize obstruction as control of resource outlets and civic thresholds.
63:10-11 expose promised future action as a temporal shield that fails at the fixed term.
summary.what_was_special: The focus did not settle into one paraphrase. Its oath-shield remained simultaneously forensic, concealing, cognitive, acoustic, economic, civic, and temporal, while water-flow, optical-film, and burial images stayed live under explicit containment. Later context repeatedly changed the mechanism without detaching it from the focus's words and constructions.
remaining_uncertainties: The s-d-d construction can foreground their own turning or their barring of others; the trace preserves the causal coupling without forcing one syntax to erase the other.
The power/right activation of y-m-n and the hydrological, optical, and mortuary outliers are branch-level resonances, not proposed replacement translations.
The arrow from repeatedly operated concealment to an inward seal is abductive; the packet also permits the seal to be read primarily as an imposed consequence.
The economic and civic contexts strongly instantiate blocking, but they do not prove that assets or jurisdiction are the sole objects protected by the oaths.
